general_conditions.label: Poor
general_conditions.description:
The perimeter has significant concerns that need attention: Empty soft drink cans and scattered paper visible around tent area and near furniture; Large black leather chair abandoned on sidewalk near tree; Large pile of feces reported outside front door; Multiple tents set up along sidewalk with belongings arranged for living 
OR
The perimeter is showing several concerns of moderate severity: Empty soft drink cans and scattered paper visible around tent area and near furniture; Large black leather chair abandoned on sidewalk near tree; Large pile of feces reported outside front door; Multiple tents set up along sidewalk with belongings arranged for living

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Scattered small refuse or litter that does not obstruct movement.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Minor: Increasing quantity, size, or spatial impact
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Empty soft drink cans and scattered paper visible around tent area and near furniture

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Bulky items or materials that are difficult to move and visually dominate space.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Moderate: Increasing quantity, size, or spatial impact
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Large black leather chair abandoned on sidewalk near tree

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Visible feces, urine staining, or biological waste residue.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Moderate: Increasing amount, spread, or proximity to pedestrians
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Large pile of feces reported outside front door

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Visible evidence of people living or sleeping in public spaces without shelter.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Elevated: Increasing number, density, or permanence
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Multiple tents set up along sidewalk with belongings arranged for living

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Intentional, expressive markings (writing, symbols, or drawings) applied to surfaces not designed for such use, without clear indicators of official or authorized purpose.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Minimal: A single small tag or mark, negligible surface coverage, easily overlooked
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Some markings visible on building walls

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Physical blockage limiting pedestrian, wheelchair, or vehicle access.
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Significant obstruction; wheelchair or stroller access is effectively blocked, pedestrians must leave the path
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Multiple tents and large furniture blocking significant portions of sidewalk

identified_conditions_of_concern.definition: Animals that are unleashed, unattended, or where conditions are unsafe for an animal or the public
identified_conditions_of_concern.severity_label: Moderate: Clear safety concern (unleashed near traffic, inadequate shelter)
identified_conditions_of_concern.description: Multiple dogs off-leash in street area near traffic
